is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae sensu stricto laboratory strains.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the kdr (L1014F) mutation.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper uses laboratory-reared strains (Kisumu, kdr-kis, and their F1 progeny) with known genotypes. It does not report genotype counts or frequencies for field-collected populations.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory reference strains (Kisumu and kdr-kis) and their crosses, not field-caught mosquitoes.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study using a dual-choice olfactometer.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains; no field collection location is relevant.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains; no field collection date is relevant.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses established laboratory strains.

supplement.evidence: All relevant data is presented in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the host-seeking behavior of laboratory-reared Anopheles gambiae s.s. strains (susceptible Kisumu and resistant kdr-kis) in a dual-choice olfactometer. It does not involve field-collected mosquitoes or report genotype frequencies for wild populations.
exclusion_reasons: The study uses laboratory-reared strains, not field-collected mosquitoes.
The study does not report genotype counts or frequencies for field-collected populations.
